evals.prompt: Trace what data goes into our RAG agent's context and what leaves our infrastructure to the model provider.
evals.expected_output: Maps inbound retrieval/tool/memory sources with trust tiers and outbound provider calls with payload contents, flags any untrusted content spliced without delimiting, and writes explore-llm-data-flow.json.

evals.prompt: We're multi-tenant - can you check whether one customer's retrieved documents could ever end up in another customer's context?
